name: Textmagic
description: TextMagic brings business SMS into your AI assistant. Send and schedule text messages, preview cost and recipients before sending, track delivery, and read incoming replies without leaving the chat. Manage your address book too: search contacts, create and update them, organize lists and tags. Every send is previewed and confirmed before it goes out, and messaging always respects your account balance and permissions. Ideal for appointment reminders, alerts, follow-ups and quick customer replies.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Textmagic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Textmagic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.textmagic.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Textmagic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Textmagic lists 28 MCP tools, including add_contacts_to_list, add_tags_to_contacts, create_contact, create_list, create_recurring_schedule, create_tag, get_account_info, get_app_link, get_contact, get_inbound_sms_messages, get_outbound_sms_sessions, and get_session_sms_messages.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Textmagic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Textmagic in communication on the Manufact MCP catalog include AgentLine: Phone Numbers for AI Agents, JooVoice, OpenMail, Granola, and Fleet Connected Apps.
Textmagic requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Textmagic is developed by Textmagic. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
